tasks.extracted: One strip per concentration at 15 concentrations from 20 to 0.2 mg/mL of weighed material in deionized water: by eye, the test band did not appear (a positive reading) above about 2 mg/mL for one seized methamphetamine sample, one seized MDMA sample and retail diphenhydramine 25 mg tablets and capsules; by image analysis (test band fainter than with fentanyl at 25 ng/mL), false positives were likely from 1 mg/mL (diphenhydramine capsules), 1.5 (methamphetamine), 2 (MDMA) and 2.5 mg/mL (diphenhydramine tablets). Seized cocaine and alprazolam, gabapentin and buprenorphine-naloxone products read negative at every concentration up to 20 mg/mL. The purity of the seized stimulants is not reported, and the diphenhydramine thresholds correspond to about 0.10 and 0.25 mg/mL of the drug itself (editors' calculation on the card from unit weights of 240 and 250 mg).
